svg.text: A threads' preset is judged by its stage-wise preset (gi_threads by gi), picture for picture. On a scene without its far field,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gi_threads lights with direct.light.threads and fills no indirect item (the preset's FAR_FIELD_ABSENT).

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gi_threads also names indirect.near_tile, which fills no item: the one-tile indirect product, a step of the tile thread with the option near_tile (off).
